// Code generated by vandorf. DO NOT EDIT.
// A React hook per route of each HTTP server, over client.ts: each gives the
// route's last result or error and whether a call is in flight, and cancels
// calls that are no longer wanted.

import * as React from "react";
import * as $c from "./client";
import type * as $t from "./types";

/**
 * Runs proc Setup through setup (`POST /api/setup` on http server web-api):
 * with args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useSetup(args?: Record<string, never> | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<Record<string, never>, $t.Ctx> {
  return $useCall($c.setup, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Hi through hi (`GET /api/hi` on http server web-api): with args,
 * whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useHi(args?: { readonly name: string; readonly ctx: $t.Ctx } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly name: string; readonly ctx: $t.Ctx }, string> {
  return $useCall($c.hi, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Calc through calc (`POST /api/calc` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function useCalc(args?: { readonly n: number } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly n: number }, number> {
  return $useCall($c.calc, args, opts);
}

/**
 * Runs proc Page through page (`GET /api/page` on http server web-api): with
 * args, whenever they change; any time with run.
 */
export function usePage(args?: { readonly ctx: $t.Ctx; readonly req: $t.Req } | null, opts?: HookOptions): CallState<{ readonly ctx: $t.Ctx; readonly req: $t.Req }, $t.PageOut> {
  return $useCall($c.page, args, opts);
}
